action_items: Enquiry submission is intentionally MOCKED prototype-only success with no persistence, per specification.
Backend suite collected no tests; this implementation has no API-bearing acceptance criterion.

checks.criterion: Homepage presents RK FITNESS as a premium black/yellow/white Hyderabad fitness brand with the requested hero headline, supporting copy, sticky navigation, and major homepage sections
checks.name: homepage-premium-sections
checks.evidence: Homepage rendered at localhost:3000 with hero heading Build strong./Build different., visible CTAs, header, all requested section testids, and no complete branch address in body text.

checks.criterion: All six homepage branch cards use the exact requested names and open the correct reusable branch route
checks.name: branch-cards-routes
checks.evidence: All six exact names and hrefs were asserted; Gudimalkapur View branch navigated to /branches/gudimalkapur and rendered its branch hero.

checks.criterion: Each branch page shows its exact full address, demo phone, 6 AM - 12 AM timing, branch-specific map embed, directions link, and call action
checks.name: branch-details-actions
checks.evidence: All six branch routes were traversed in SPA; exact address markers/postcodes, ordered demo phones 9998887771-7776, 6:00 AM — 12:00 AM, Google Maps iframe/directions URLs, and tel call actions passed.

checks.criterion: Membership prices are exact and every plan CTA opens the enquiry flow
checks.name: membership-enquiry-success
checks.evidence: Monthly ₹1,800, 3 Months ₹4,500, 6 Months ₹7,500, Yearly ₹14,000 with BEST VALUE, and Day Pass ₹200 asserted; Monthly Join now opened modal with preselected interest.

checks.criterion: Enquiry form supports the requested fields/options and shows the exact prototype success message
checks.name: enquiry-form-submission
checks.evidence: Name, phone, branch, message and all nine interest options were exercised; submission displayed the exact requested thank-you and follow-up messages.

checks.criterion: Mobile experience is usable with sticky header, hamburger menu, single-column branch cards, tap-friendly CTAs, no horizontal overflow, and readable content
checks.name: mobile-navigation-and-layout
checks.evidence: 390x844 viewport showed hamburger navigation, navigated to memberships, had no document horizontal overflow, and opened a usable mobile enquiry modal/form.

checks.criterion: Gallery and placeholder content follow the content rules
checks.name: gallery-placeholders-lightbox
checks.evidence: Results and trainer placeholder copy rendered; gallery tile opened a visible lightbox and close action removed it.

checks.criterion: Instagram and footer conversion paths are present without a broken feed integration
checks.name: instagram-footer-conversions
checks.evidence: Static Instagram preview/follow URL, footer logo/tagline, six branch links, contact/hours, and © 2026 RK FITNESS. All Rights Reserved. passed.
